title: SKE Crystal Plus Strawberry Kiwi Shake Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Strawberry Kiwi Shake flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods blend sweet, juicy strawberries and tangy kiwis with a smooth, creamy milkshake finish. This decadent flavour delivers the perfect combination of fruity freshness and rich, velvety undertones, making it a truly indulgent and satisfying vape. Compatible with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods are designed for ultimate convenience. Each pod comes preloaded with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction for an enjoyable mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. The advanced 1.1ohm mesh coil technology ensures excellent flavour and consistent vapour production with every puff. With a user-friendly, mess-free design, the Strawberry Kiwi Shake pods are perfect for vapers seeking a hassle-free and flavour-packed vaping experience. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
